title: Rational and $\Qlb$ purity
statement:
In the purity conventions of this chapter ([def-pur-conventions] fixed setting),
let $f:X\to Y$ be a smooth separated morphism of pure relative dimension $d$
between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and let $K$ lie in the $E$-coefficient
category of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], respectively the
$\Qlb$-coefficient category of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], presented
by a normalized integral system (a lattice) as in
[def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Then

$$
\gamma_{f,K}:Lf^*K(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Rf^!K
$$

is an isomorphism in the corresponding category: rationalization along
[prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport] and finite extension of coefficient
fields carry the adic purity isomorphism of
[thm-pur-adic-reconstruction] to the $E$- and $\Qlb$-purity
isomorphisms.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-rational-lattice-adic-domain] on $X,Y$. Every lattice $K_0$ representing $K$ is in the integral finite-Tor domain. The smooth separated pure-dimensional hypotheses therefore allow [thm-pur-adic-reconstruction]. Take the simultaneous linear natural family $\gamma_E:H_E^{\rm int}\Rightarrow G_E^{\rm int}$ of [lem-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality], with exactly those finite reductions and its specified coefficient comparisons. This uses a compatible choice, not uniqueness of coherent lifts.

source.place: Step 1: lattice domain and compatible adic family

proof.text: By [prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport], this exact integral linear transformation extends to all rational morphisms with component $Q_E(\gamma_{E,K_0})$. Apply [lem-pur-rational-scalar-comparison-identification] to identify its functors with $H_E=Lf_E^*(-)(d)[2d]$ and $G_E=Rf_E^!$. Its inverse is $Q_E(\gamma_{E,K_0}^{-1})$: functoriality carries the two integral inverse equations to identities. Naturality on rational morphisms applies to any rational isomorphism between lattice presentations, proving independence of the presentation. Thus the required rational purity is obtained by rationalization.

For every $E\subset F$, [lem-pur-rational-scalar-comparison-identification] gives the exact comparisons $a,b$, the square $b\circ T(\gamma_E)=\gamma_F\circ a$ and the inverse square $T(\gamma_E^{-1})\circ b^{-1}=a^{-1}\circ\gamma_F^{-1}$. It also identifies ordinary completed tensor with strict adic scalar extension and the exceptional comparison with the defining counit mate; the unit, associator and shift equations are retained. These are precisely the compatibility hypotheses for both families in [prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors].

Apply [lem-pur-common-stage-smooth-operation-identification] to these families. At $(E,K)$ the descended maps are represented by $\gamma_{E,K}$ and $\gamma_{E,K}^{-1}$; their actions on a common-stage arrow are the displayed $a^{-1}H_M(u)a$ and $b^{-1}G_M(u)b$ formulas, independent of its representative. Their composites are represented by the two finite-stage identities, hence are identities. The lemma identifies their source and target functors, including map actions, with $Lf^*(-)(d)[2d]$ and $Rf^!$. This proves the claimed $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ purity and independence of the finite coefficient stage.

blueprint_update.statement:
Work in the purity conventions of [def-pur-conventions], let
$f:X\to Y$ be smooth separated of relative dimension $d$ over a
separated finite-type $k$-scheme, and let $K$ lie in the $E$-coefficient
category of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], respectively the
$\Qlb$-coefficient category of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], presented
by a normalized integral system (a lattice) as in
[def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Then

$$
\gamma_{f,K}:Lf^*K(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Rf^!K
$$

is an isomorphism in the corresponding category: rationalization along
[prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport] and finite extension of coefficient
fields carry the adic purity isomorphism of
[thm-pur-adic-reconstruction] to the $E$- and $\Qlb$-purity
isomorphisms.

proof.text:
Step 1: the $E$-stage. An $E$-object $K$ of
[def-weil-pbc-rational-category] is presented by a lattice
$K_{\mathcal O_E}\in D^b_{ctf}(\cdot,\mathcal O_E)$ with
$K_E=K_{\mathcal O_E}\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}E$. The adic purity
isomorphism

$$
\gamma_{f,K_{\mathcal O_E}}:\ Lf^*K_{\mathcal O_E}(d)[2d]
\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Rf^!K_{\mathcal O_E}
$$

of [thm-pur-adic-reconstruction] for the lattice, extended along
the exact functor $-\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}E$ (exact because
$\mathcal O_E\to E$ is flat), is an isomorphism

$$
\gamma_{f,K_E}:\ Lf^*K_E(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Rf^!K_E
$$

between the $E$-objects, i.e. the $E$-purity isomorphism of
[def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Step 2: the $\Qlb$-stage.
A $\Qlb$-object of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category] is represented
by an $E$-object $K_E$ for some finite $E/\Ql$ (no idempotent is
needed, the finite-stage categories being idempotent complete); the
$\Qlb$-purity isomorphism is the transport of the $E$-purity
isomorphism of Step 1 along the scalar extension
$E\hookrightarrow\Qlb$, well defined by the independence of
[prop-pur-rational-purity-transitivity-summands].
